claim: ADR 0281 / A-007: the LAST migration that defines public.apply_stock_movement gives it p_occurred_at timestamptz DEFAULT NULL and dates the ledger row LEAST(COALESCE(p_occurred_at, now()), now()), so a POS sale is booked on the day its check closed, never in the future. Reading the last definer, not one file, means a later migration that redefines the function without the argument fails this row (ADR 0281 F3). Measured 2026-10-03 on fix/pos-sales-dated-at-sale-time: exit 0; on origin/main 8c673db4b the last definer is a_stock_write_names_its_house and the row exits 1.
verify: python3 -c "import glob,re,sys; fs=sorted(f for f in glob.glob('supabase/migrations/*.sql') if re.search(r'CREATE (OR REPLACE )?FUNCTION public\.apply_stock_movement\(', open(f,encoding='utf-8',errors='replace').read())); b=open(fs[-1],encoding='utf-8',errors='replace').read(); sys.exit(0 if 'p_occurred_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL' in b and 'LEAST(COALESCE(p_occurred_at, now()), now())' in b else 1)"

claim: ADR 0281 / A-007: the LAST migration that defines public.record_glass_pour gives it p_occurred_at timestamptz DEFAULT NULL and dates the ledger row it writes when a pour opens bottles by LEAST(COALESCE(p_occurred_at, now()), now()). Reading the last definer catches a later CREATE OR REPLACE with the 8-argument signature, which would add a second overload and leave the gateway's call on the old body (ADR 0281 F3). The glasspour lane's migration a_short_pour_opens_the_next_bottle (ADR 0285) merged first (#600, fb862aa57) with that 8-argument signature; a_pos_sale_is_dated_by_its_check now sorts after it and re-creates the function on its body, and the claims row ADR-0285-A-SHORT-POUR-OPENS-THE-NEXT-BOTTLE checks that the same last definer still carries the cross-lot draw. Measured 2026-10-04: exit 0 on this branch, exit 1 on origin/main fb862aa57 (last definer: a_short_pour_opens_the_next_bottle).
verify: python3 -c "import glob,re,sys; fs=sorted(f for f in glob.glob('supabase/migrations/*.sql') if re.search(r'CREATE (OR REPLACE )?FUNCTION public\.record_glass_pour\(', open(f,encoding='utf-8',errors='replace').read())); b=open(fs[-1],encoding='utf-8',errors='replace').read(); sys.exit(0 if 'p_occurred_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL' in b and 'LEAST(COALESCE(p_occurred_at, now()), now())' in b else 1)"
